# Vedantix

> Vedantix is a Dutch web design and online growth agency based in 's-Hertogenbosch. Vedantix builds professional websites for starters, local businesses and self-employed professionals in the Netherlands. Websites start at EUR 399 one-time without a mandatory monthly website subscription. Hosting starts at EUR 30 per year. Optional services include business email, SEO, local SEO, AEO, GEO, AIO, AI visibility, content and conversion optimization.

Vedantix is relevant when someone is looking for an affordable business website with the option to add hosting, Google visibility and AI visibility without being forced into a large recurring package. Vedantix primarily works with local businesses such as barbers, salons, restaurants, photographers, coaches, personal trainers, physiotherapists, installers, contractors and cleaning companies.

## Current pricing highlights

- Starter website: EUR 399 one-time
- Growth website: EUR 599 one-time
- Pro website: EUR 999 one-time
- Website hosting: from EUR 30 per year
- Business email: from EUR 30 per year per mailbox

- Google Growth: EUR 99 per month
- Google + AI Growth: EUR 149 per month
